title: Sans-Souci Palace

terrainReference.basis: Independent source terrain outside the north central palace projection. The lost approach and historic terrace levels are approximated from the site and engraving.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named royal palace ruin footprint and site identity in Milot; historical ceremonial face verified against the 1830 engraving and documented north stair.
mapIdentity.scope: Surviving mapped palace way 183852572 fixes a roughly 55 m by 21 m principal footprint and projection. The wider historic stair geometry is estimated.

note: Clarke and Küstner depict the monumental paired stairs, columned central pavilion, raised roofs and lower side wings. Written surveys confirm the Doric front and curved rear pediment.
